class.name: CgamePlatformBackend
class.description: [CgamePlatformBackend] is the contract between [CgamePlatformServices] and the host platform: accounts, raw save storage, achievements, presence, entitlements, controller pairing, application lifecycle, network state, text input and content restrictions. This class cannot be instantiated. Use [CgameDesktopPlatformBackend] for a filesystem implementation or [CgameMockPlatformBackend] for an in-memory implementation that can reproduce console-style failures (quota, sign-out, controller loss, suspend). A licensed platform port adds its own C++ subclass; the module itself contains no vendor SDK code. The save methods work on raw bytes. [CgamePlatformServices] wraps the payload in an integrity envelope before it reaches [method write_save].

method.name: achievement_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of all unlocked achievements.

method.name: backend_name
method.description: Returns a short identifier of the backend, for example [code]"desktop"[/code] or [code]"mock_console"[/code].

method.name: controller_owner
method.description: Returns the user id that [param device_id] is paired to, or an empty string if the device was never paired.

method.name: current_user
method.description: Returns the id of the signed-in user, or an empty string if nobody is signed in.

method.name: delete_save
method.description: Deletes the main, temporary and backup files of [param slot].

method.name: disconnect_controller
method.description: Marks [param device_id] as disconnected and emits [signal controller_disconnected] if it was connected.

method.name: grant_entitlement
method.description: Grants the entitlement [param id] (for example a purchased add-on).

method.name: has_entitlement
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the entitlement [param id] was granted.

method.name: is_achievement_unlocked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the achievement [param id] is unlocked.

method.name: is_controller_connected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the controller [param device_id] is currently connected.

method.name: is_restricted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the content restriction [param kind] is active. See [method set_restriction].

method.name: is_signed_in
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a user is signed in.

method.name: is_suspended
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the application is suspended.

method.name: network_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the network is reachable.

method.name: pair_controller
method.description: Pairs [param device_id] with [param user_id] and marks the device as connected.

method.name: presence
method.description: Returns the presence text last set with [method set_presence].

method.name: read_save_backup
method.description: Returns the backup copy of [param slot], or an empty array if there is none.

method.name: read_save_main
method.description: Returns the main copy of [param slot], or an empty array if there is none.

method.name: reconnect_controller
method.description: Reconnects a previously paired controller and emits [signal controller_connected]. Does nothing for an unpaired or already connected device.

method.name: request_text_input
method.description: Asks the platform keyboard for text. Returns [code]{"ok": bool, "text": String}[/code]. The base implementation returns [code]ok = false[/code] so that the caller shows its own on-screen keyboard.

method.name: resume
method.description: Leaves the suspended state and emits [signal lifecycle_changed] with [code]false[/code]. Does nothing if not suspended.

method.name: save_used_bytes
method.description: Returns the number of bytes currently used by all save files, including temporary and backup copies.

method.name: set_network
method.description: Changes the network state and emits [signal network_changed] if it differs.

method.name: set_presence
method.description: Sets the presence (rich status) text.

method.name: set_restriction
method.description: Enables or disables a content restriction such as parental controls. Known kinds are [code]"chat"[/code], [code]"user_content"[/code], [code]"purchases"[/code] and [code]"online"[/code].

method.name: sign_in
method.description: Signs [param user_id] in and emits [signal user_signed_in].

method.name: sign_out
method.description: Signs the current user out and emits [signal user_signed_out]. Does nothing if nobody is signed in.

method.name: suspend
method.description: Enters the suspended state and emits [signal lifecycle_changed] with [code]true[/code]. Does nothing if already suspended.

method.name: unlock_achievement
method.description: Unlocks the achievement [param id]. Returns [code]true[/code] only if it was newly unlocked.

method.name: uses_native_keyboard
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method request_text_input] can show a platform keyboard.

method.name: write_save
method.description: Writes [param bytes] to [param slot] and returns a [enum CgamePlatformServices.SaveResult] value. Implementations must write a temporary file first and only then replace the main file, keeping the previous main file as backup, so an interrupted write never destroys the last good save.

members.member: Maximum number of bytes all save files may use. [code]0[/code] means unlimited. Exceeding it makes [method write_save] return [constant CgamePlatformServices.SAVE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED].

Test hook. If [code]true[/code], [method write_save] stops after the temporary file was written and before it is committed, as after a power loss, and returns [constant CgamePlatformServices.SAVE_INTERRUPTED].

signal.name: user_signed_out
signal.description: Emitted when the user [param user_id] signed out.

signal.name: user_signed_in
signal.description: Emitted when the user [param user_id] signed in.

signal.name: controller_disconnected
signal.description: Emitted when the controller [param device_id] was disconnected.

signal.name: controller_connected
signal.description: Emitted when the controller [param device_id] was reconnected.

signal.name: lifecycle_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the application was suspended or resumed.

signal.name: network_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the network availability changed.
